title: Forward proper/open lambda transport under the canonical system bridge
statement: For normalized integral-system Operations, Compositors and OpenComparisons and the canonical bridge, the forward properOpenLambda intertwines the source bridge on J_k followed by R_p and inverse image along i with the target direct bridge on r and the intrinsic proper/open lambda.

source.place: Coefficient-system realization: four-factor proper/open lambda word

proof.text: Use the two component expansions and the prefix and tail bridge equations, all expressed in the explicitly constructed diagram. Precompose the tail equation by the two chosen prefix components. Postcompose the prefix equation by the three intrinsic tail components. Associativity identifies the intermediate word. The generic categorical pasting proof combines these equations and the two expansions into the forward bridge. Unfold only the diagram projections for the five outer components.

theorem properOpenLambda_bridge (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
    (a : OpenComparisons l E o c) (b : CanonicalBridge l E o)
    {U V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W)
    (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i]
    [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p]
    (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (M : System l E U) :
    (properOpenLambda l E o c a k r p i h).hom.app M ≫ (b.push l E r).hom.app M =
      (pull l E i).map ((Operations.push l E o p).map ((b.shriek l E k).hom.app M) ≫
        (b.push l E p).hom.app
          ((ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.J (scalarRings l E)
            (scalarTransitions l E) k).obj M)) ≫
      (b.pull l E i).hom.app
        ((ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.J (scalarRings l E)
          (scalarTransitions l E) k ⋙ ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.R
            (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) p).obj M) ≫
      (ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.lambda
        (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) k r p i h).hom.app M
